cfa.decidedBy: BAYERPAT keyword (statistics used only for the green axis)

notes: green sites measured on the main diagonal; pattern mirrored to GBRG to match

linearity.rule: nonLinear = median >= 0.05 OR (history stretch AND median >= 0.02)

historyCards: MIRROR same pixels as fixture-seestar.fit, byte for byte.
MIRROR The ONLY difference is BAYERPAT: GRBG there, RGGB here.
MIRROR The greens are on the MAIN diagonal in the pixels, and
MIRROR RGGB puts them on the anti-diagonal, so the reader has
MIRROR to mirror the declared pattern to GBRG to match what it
MIRROR measured. GBRG swaps red and blue against GRBG, so this
MIRROR frame comes out with the colours exchanged -- which is
MIRROR correct: the lattice settles the green axis, and only
MIRROR the header can say which of the other two sites is red.
MIRROR External truth, from neither implementation.
